verdicts.title: Package agent is a god package; extract Session-free subsystems leaf-first
verdicts.note: Core numbers verified: 176 non-test files/105,781 lines, 957 test files/374,987 lines, Session struct spans 1,017 lines (session.go:109), testConfig has 91 fields, 1,087 Session methods in 97 files, resourceCapsFromEnv has one non-test caller (env_info.go:26). Real, but severity high overstates it: no evidence of bugs, and the compile-time/recompile-cost claim is unmeasured (AGENTS.md says measure in CI, not locally). agent already has many subpackages (transcript, schema, doctor, internal/*), so extraction is ongoing. Steps 1-3 are cheap leaf moves; step 4 (transcriptview) exports many helpers and depends on findings 3/11/14/26 first. Commit count claim (569) not reproduced (519 via git log).
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Keep steps 1-3 only as concrete PRs (hostresources, memory pages after 15/16, envsnapshot); treat 4-5 as contingent on shrinking exported surface. Do not frame as a standalone refactor; each move should be justified by a boundary (e.g. a second consumer). Measure test-binary build time in CI before and after.

verdicts.title: One delegate-status record copied across four struct types and mappers
verdicts.note: Duplication confirmed: agent/status.go:124 DelegateStatusInfo (51 json tags), events.DelegateUpdatedData (52), server/server.go:105 DelegateStatusInfo (50), appwire.EvenerDelegateInfo (54); mappers at server/appwire_runtime.go:2827, cmd/evener-hub/app_threadread.go:1278, cmd/evener/serve.go:2315 are ~30-line positional copies; plus three clone helpers for the same *bool/*int64 (cloneServerBool, cloneHubBool, cloneServeBool). Real drift: server.DelegateStatusInfo lacks latest_intent that agent's has. HOWEVER the fix plan is unsafe: I diffed json tags and agent/server structs use snake_case (delegate_id, run_generation) while appwire.EvenerDelegateInfo uses camelCase (delegateId, runGeneration) and has extra fields (logicalOwnerSessionId, reportPreview, reportPreviewTruncated); events.DelegateUpdatedData adds ancestor_session_ids. 'Alias agent type to appwire and keep appwire tags' would silently change the daemon status wire. Severity stays high given evidenced drift.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Step 1: make server.DelegateStatusInfo a type alias of agent.DelegateStatusInfo (server already imports agent) and delete the serve.go copy loop and its cloneServe* helpers (additive: latest_intent starts appearing). Step 2: one exported agent mapper (method on agent.DelegateStatusInfo returning appwire.EvenerDelegateInfo, deep-copying pointers once) replacing appDelegateFromDetailedStatus and appwireDelegateFromAgentStatus. Step 3: keep delegateUpdatedDataFromStatus but add a reflection field-coverage test across the three types. Do NOT alias to appwire unless the snake_case consumers are first identified and migrated. Guard with JSON golden for each wire.

verdicts.title: Transcript read header+entries loop hand-rolled multiple times with drifted limits
verdicts.note: Verified: fork.go:191 readForkParent hard-codes 10*1024*1024 (fork.go:105,133,211; aside.go:58) while transcript.DefaultMaxLineBytes = 128<<20 (agent/transcript/transcript.go:32) and agent/transcript_read.go:16 redefines transcriptJSONLMaxLineBytes = 128<<20 (a third copy beside transcript.go:34). ReadLine returns ErrLineTooLong over cap, so fork/aside fail on 10-128 MiB lines that resume reads. ReadLine/DecodeHeader hits in session_attention.go (2), doctor/transcript.go (2), apptranscript (1), transcriptindex (3), image_serve (1), thread_history (1), reconstruct (2), transcript_render (3). Not all are the same shape (indexers track offsets, doctor tracks line numbers), so 'six' is fair for the full-read sites, fewer for pure duplicates. Note maxScanToken is a test-injected dep in forkSessionDeps, so tests rely on small caps.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Start with the concrete bug: red test forking a transcript with a >10 MiB line, then make fork/aside use transcript.DefaultMaxLineBytes (keep maxScanToken test seam). Then lift one shared reader only if 2+ other callers port cleanly; do not force indexers/doctor into it.

verdicts.note: Verified: agent/internal/contextmgr/fork_summarize.go:104 truncate slices s[:limit]+"..." at a byte offset (can split a multibyte rune in text sent to the cheap model; used at lines 56-80); project_docs.go:164 truncateDoc loop duplicates the runetrim.Cut idiom; appwire/delegate_roster.go:33 truncateRosterText is a copy of activitybound.Truncate (same walk, same cutAt logic); contextmgr context_manager.go:~1090 also cuts cmd[:60] by bytes.

verdicts.title: System-reminder wrapping spelled several ways
verdicts.note: Verified: system_notification.go:43-65 systemReminderBlock/Builder/finish re-spell tags (builder callers only task_reminders.go:25,83); raw literals task_reminders.go:157-252, session_queue.go:378 wrapHookContext, session_compaction.go:463. BUT the plan is unsafe in two places: wrapHookContext and the compaction pointer wrap '<SYSTEM-REMINDER>' + text + '</SYSTEM-REMINDER>' with NO newlines, while sysmsg.ReminderBlock adds newlines, so switching changes model-visible bytes and the sysmsg.IsReminderBlock invariant would not hold for them. And hasTaskListAnnouncement (task_reminders.go:167-197) already checks the in-memory steeringQueue first; the transcript read is the crash-recovery fallback (queue is lost on restart) and a bounded tail read could miss an earlier delivery. Variant: v09 and the Fisher note are at task_reminders.go:18,60.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Only collapse builder/finish onto sysmsg.ReminderBlock (same bytes) and make withCurrentStep operate pre-wrap. Leave wrapHookContext/compaction literals or give sysmsg a distinct inline-wrap helper deliberately. Keep the transcript fallback or persist a delivered flag in meta; do not use a tail read.

verdicts.title: Transcript job-result renderer keeps two hand-maintained key allowlists
verdicts.note: Verified lists exist (jobResultKnownKeys 51 entries at transcript_render.go:1461, jobResultMetadataKeys 11 entries at :1522, jobResult struct 19 fields at session_outline.go:49) and the comment at :1491 cites commit hashes. But the plan's premise is wrong: jobResultKnownKeys is the union of keys from three producer structs (jobResult, stableDelegateCreateResult, delegateSendResult), not the jobResult struct; and jobResultMetadataKeys (11 keys, not 35) is a deliberate display subset, not derivable from tags. A drift-detector test (TestJobResultKnownKeysCoversLiveDelegateShapes) already guards the known-keys list.
verdicts.revised_fix_plan: Optionally derive jobResultKnownKeys by reflection over the three producer structs' JSON tags (delete the literal map and history comment); keep jobResultMetadataKeys as is. Low priority.

verdicts.title: Delegate sandbox policy engine in session file set; invalid_request carried twice
